name: Time Picker
summary: A field for a time of day. It is a real <input type="time"> inside a box the library draws, so the browser validates the hour, the arrow keys walk the segments and the reader's own clock opens it.
summaryZh: 一个填时刻的字段。它是一个真正的 <input type="time">,放在库画的盒子里,所以时刻由浏览器校验,方向键可以在各段之间走,读者自己的时钟也会由它打开。

variants.name: Single time
variants.note: One time in one field. The base class on its own is this layout, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Range
variants.note: Two times in one box, with a rule between them. The markup carries a second input and the separator.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The field follows the theme's small control height and the time takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default field. The base class is already this height, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The field follows the theme's large control height.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The field paints a flat surface and takes the derived disabled colour, so the time is still readable.

states.name: Invalid
states.note: The border turns to the danger colour when the browser says the time is outside the range it was given. The user-invalid pseudo-class waits for the reader to have been there, so an empty field is not red before anyone touches it.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the field, because the field is what the reader is typing in.

parts.name: Input
parts.note: The real <input type="time">. It is borderless inside the field, so the field and the clock read as one control.

parts.name: Clock
parts.note: The clock face, drawn from a border and two hands. It is decorative: the button that actually opens the picker is the browser's own.

parts.name: Separator
parts.note: The rule between the two times of a range.

props.name: value
props.description: The time in the field. It is the input's own value, in the browser's own format — a class cannot carry a time.
props.descriptionZh: 字段里的时刻。它是 input 自己的值,用浏览器自己的格式 —— 类带不了时刻。

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest time the field accepts. It is the input's own min attribute, so the browser enforces it and marks the field out of range when it is not met.
props.descriptionZh: 字段接受的最早时刻。它是原生 min 属性,由浏览器来管,不满足时浏览器会把字段标成超出范围。

props.name: max
props.description: The latest time the field accepts. It is the input's own max attribute.
props.descriptionZh: 字段接受的最晚时刻。它是原生 max 属性。

props.name: step
props.description: How fine the time is, in seconds. It is the input's own step attribute, so the arrow keys move by it too.
props.descriptionZh: 时刻有多细,单位是秒。它是原生 step 属性,方向键也按它走。

props.name: required
props.description: Makes the time necessary. It is the native required attribute, so the browser asks for it.
props.descriptionZh: 让时刻必填。它是原生 required 属性,由浏览器来问。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让字段不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: type
props.description: Whether the field holds one time or two. The single field is the base class on its own; the range field adds um-time-picker--range.
props.descriptionZh: 字段里是一个时刻还是两个。一个时刻是只写基础类;时间区间再加上 um-time-picker--range。

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The clock face. It is decorative and drawn by the library, so it takes no text of its own.
slots.descriptionZh: 时钟图标。它是装饰性的,由库画出来,所以自己不带文字。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the time changes. It is the browser's own event on the input — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 时刻变了的时候触发。这是 input 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on every keystroke in the field. It is the browser's own event on the input.
events.descriptionZh: 在字段里每敲一个字就触发。这是 input 上的浏览器原生事件。

a11y.notes: The field is a real <input type="time">, so the browser validates it, the arrow keys walk through the hours and the minutes and a screen reader announces it as a time field with its own segments. Give it a real <label for> or an aria-label — the drawn clock is decorative and carries no text. The button that opens the picker is the browser's own and is left where the browser puts it; the library's clock is decoration beside it, not a second control.
a11y.notesZh: 字段是真正的 <input type="time">,所以浏览器会校验它,方向键可以在小时和分钟之间走,读屏也会把它当作带分段的时刻字段播报。给它一个真正的 <label for> 或 aria-label —— 画出来的时钟是装饰性的,自己不带文字。打开选择器的那个按钮是浏览器自己的,库把它留在浏览器放的位置;库画的那个时钟是它旁边的装饰,不是第二个控件。

examples.title: Single time
examples.description: One time in one field. The clock is the library's own decoration; the button that opens the picker is the browser's, on the other side of the time.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个时刻放在一个字段里。时钟是库自己画的装饰;打开选择器的按钮是浏览器的,在时刻的另一边。

examples.title: Range
examples.description: Two times in one box, with a rule between them. The markup carries a second input and the separator.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个盒子里两个时刻,中间一条线。标记里多了一个 input 和那条分隔线。

examples.title: Out of range
examples.description: A field with a window the browser enforces. A time outside the window turns the border to the danger colour — but only after the reader has been there, so an empty field is not red on arrival.
examples.descriptionZh: 带一个由浏览器来管的时段。落在时段之外的时刻会把描边变成危险色 —— 但只在读者动过之后,所以刚打开的空字段不会是红的。

notes: The picker is the browser's own, and the library does not take it away: hiding the native indicator would remove the only way to open the clock without JavaScript. The drawn clock beside the time is decoration, so it is hidden from the screen reader and the field needs a label of its own. The indicator's colour follows the reader's system rather than the mood, because the contract has no role for "this mood is a dark one" and a wrong colour was not an option.
notesZh: 选择器是浏览器自己的,库没有把它拿走:把原生的那个图标藏起来,就会断掉不用 JavaScript 时唯一的打开方式。时刻旁边画的那个时钟是装饰,所以它对读屏是藏起来的,字段自己得有一个标签。那个图标的颜色跟的是读者的系统设置而不是这套 mood,因为契约里没有「这套 mood 是深色的」这种角色,而写错一个颜色是不行的。
